compatibility.overlay: Independent environment effects. No water, foam or bubbles painted into the character.

production.method: Image generation from existing character identity and native-size extraction
production.prompt: Exactly the player character in the attached canonical sprite. Front view of the same elf with camera slightly above, crouch on both feet, reach down with both hands, lift an unseen lid, straighten back up. Eight frames in a wide 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, chronological. Each frame occupies only the center 57 percent of its cell and is opaque human paint with wide empty real transparent-alpha margins throughout. Preserve same clothing, skin, face and exact proportion. No object scene, water or residue, no background, floor, lighting effect, labels or checkerboard.
production.encoding: WebP lossless, verified RGBA including fully transparent pixels

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct WEBP phases verified
review.visual: Individual transparent poses visually reviewed for heading, silhouette and separation from VFX. Project review controls promotion.
